events: What if every time you let out string, your kite flew three times higher?
Sunday at the beach. Dale bought a kite shaped like a fish.
Ninety meters. The seagulls are confused.
Eight hundred meters. Almost the Burj Khalifa.
Sixty five kilometers. Past every cloud and every plane.
Five hundred ninety kilometers. Above the space station.
One hundred forty three million kilometers. Almost to the Sun. The kite is on fire.
Dale is still holding the string.
The real part: the highest single kite ever flown reached about four thousand eight hundred eighty meters, in Australia in twenty fourteen.
